section: Payment and Settlement Systems & NPCI Ecosystem

metadata.source: Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007 (PSSA), NPCI Official Portal, RBI DPSS
metadata.exam_weightage: Extremely High (9-14 Questions across Mains shifts)

npci_overview.established: 2008 (incorporated under Section 8 of Companies Act 2013 / Section 25 of Companies Act 1956 as a not-for-profit company)
npci_overview.initiative_of: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Indian Banks' Association (IBA)
npci_overview.promoter_banks: Originally promoted by 10 major core banks (SBI, PNB, BoB, Canara, Union Bank, BoI, ICICI, HDFC, Citibank, HSBC)

subsidiaries.name: NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL)
subsidiaries.purpose: Deployment of RuPay and UPI outside India

subsidiaries.name: NPCI Bharat BillPay Limited (NBBL)
subsidiaries.purpose: Operation and growth of Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS)

systems.name: Unified Payments Interface (UPI)
systems.launch_date: April 11, 2016 (by then RBI Governor Dr. Raghuram Rajan)
systems.underlying_rail: Built on Immediate Payment Service (IMPS) infrastructure
systems.addressing_mechanism: Virtual Payment Address (VPA / UPI ID) eliminating need to share bank account or IFSC

transaction_limits.standard_per_transaction: ₹1,00,000 (₹1 Lakh) per transaction (individual banks may set lower internal limits)
transaction_limits.capital_markets_collections: ₹2,00,000 (₹2 Lakh) for select verified merchant collections
transaction_limits.special_categories_limit: ₹5,00,000 (₹5 Lakh) per transaction for: (1) Hospitals & Medical Care, (2) Educational Institutions, (3) IPO applications via ASBA, (4) RBI Retail Direct scheme investments

sub_products.name: UPI Lite
sub_products.concept: On-device local wallet for small-value transactions without sending request to remitter bank's core banking system (CBS), requiring NO UPI PIN

sub_products.name: UPI 123Pay
sub_products.target: Over 40 crore feature phone users without internet access
four_technologies: App functionality on feature phones (OEM embedded)

sub_products.name: UPI Lite X
sub_products.technology: Near Field Communication (NFC) enabling 100% offline peer-to-peer and merchant payments even with zero internet connectivity

systems.name: National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT)
systems.operator: Operated and maintained directly by Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
systems.settlement_type: Deferred Net Settlement (DNS) in half-hourly batches (48 batches every day)
systems.maximum_limit: No maximum limit prescribed by RBI for account-to-account online transfers
systems.cash_remittance_walk_in: Maximum ₹50,000 per transaction for walk-in customers without an account
systems.indo_nepal_facility: Under Indo-Nepal Remittance Scheme, maximum remittance is ₹2,00,000 per transaction (for walk-in customers without bank account, cap is ₹50,000 with max 12 remittances a year)

systems.name: Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS)
systems.operator: Operated and maintained directly by Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
systems.settlement_type: Real-time individual gross settlement (each transaction settled continuously one-by-one on RBI's books without netting)
systems.nature: Intended for high-value transactions requiring immediate unconditioned finality

systems.name: Immediate Payment Service (IMPS)
systems.maximum_limit: ₹5,00,000 (₹5 Lakh) per transaction (raised from ₹2 Lakh in October 2021)
systems.identifiers: Can route using Mobile Number + MMID (Mobile Money Identifier, a 7-digit unique code) OR Account Number + IFSC

systems.name: National Automated Clearing House (NACH)
systems.function: Web-based high-volume, centralized electronic clearing system for handling bulk recurring debit and credit transactions

variants.nach_credit: Bulk payouts like dividend, interest, salary, pension, government subsidies (DBT)
variants.nach_debit: Bulk collections like loan EMIs, mutual fund SIPs, utility bills, insurance premiums
variants.e_mandate: Electronic mandate registration via Aadhaar OTP or Net Banking/Debit Card, eliminating physical paper ECS forms

systems.name: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS)
systems.channel: Micro-ATMs / Point of Sale (PoS) terminals operated by Business Correspondents (Bank Mitras)
systems.authentication: Biometric (Fingerprint or Iris scan) matching with UIDAI central database
systems.significance: Crucial driver for doorstep financial inclusion in rural unbanked regions

systems.name: FASTag (NETC Ecosystem)
systems.operator: National Electronic Toll Collection (NETC) run by NPCI under IHMCL / NHAI mandate
systems.technology: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) passive tag operating on EPC Class 1 Gen 2 standards
systems.function: Affixed on vehicle windscreen, enables electronic contactless toll payment directly from linked prepaid wallet or bank account without stopping

systems.name: Central Bank Digital Currency (Digital Rupee - e₹)
systems.issuer: Reserve Bank of India (statutory amendment to Section 22 & 24 of RBI Act via Finance Act, 2022)
systems.definition: Legal tender issued by a central bank in digital form, appearing on RBI's balance sheet as a liability, freely convertible 1:1 against physical cash
systems.interest: CBDC does NOT earn any interest (to prevent disintermediation and flight of bank deposits)

pilots.use_case: Settlement of secondary market transactions in Government Securities among participating scheduled banks
Person-to-Person (P2P) and Person-to-Merchant (P2M) digital token transactions via dedicated digital token wallets

systems.interoperability: UPI QR code interoperability rolled out allowing users to scan any standard UPI merchant QR code to pay using Digital Rupee (e₹) wallet

exam_traps.trap: Believing NEFT and RTGS are operated by NPCI.
exam_traps.fact: NEFT and RTGS are owned, operated, and maintained directly by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). UPI and IMPS are operated by NPCI.

exam_traps.trap: Thinking RTGS has a minimum limit of ₹1 Lakh.
exam_traps.fact: RTGS has a statutory minimum limit of ₹2,00,000 (₹2 Lakh). There is NO upper limit.

exam_traps.trap: Assuming Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC / e₹) earns savings interest.
exam_traps.fact: CBDC is explicitly non-interest-bearing to prevent sudden massive flight of deposits away from commercial banks.

exam_traps.trap: Thinking UPI per-transaction limit is ₹1 Lakh in all situations.
exam_traps.fact: Standard limit is ₹1 Lakh, but the limit is ₹5 Lakh for Hospitals, Educational Institutions, IPOs, and RBI Retail Direct.
